entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support complex properties on owned types in JSON-mapped owned collections #39692
  • GroupBy with an aggregate over a navigation drops query filters from other subqueries in the projection (11.0 regression) #39690
  • SQL Server: strings longer than 4000 characters come back null when projecting JSON collection elements #39689
  • [PHISHING] *.EntityFrameworkCore.Design domain is phishing / malware #39688
  • FreeTextTable: query filter of the source entity is applied with an undeclared alias #39686

Closed

  • Migrations script not using IDesignTimeDbContextFactory #25053
    12.0-preview1
  • Set SqlConnection.RegisteredApplication to identify EF Core telemetry #39699
    12.0-preview1
  • Switch to using the new SqlClient user-agent feature #36571
  • Migrator retains every pending migration's target model for the whole Migrate call #39339
    12.0-preview1
  • Scaffold-DbContext generates incorrect nav property on foreign key with filtered unique index #11298
    12.0-preview1
  • Split query + projection with Skip/Take: paging subquery still has no key ordering in EF 10, child collections come back empty #39206
    12.0-preview1
  • Allow multiple EntityTypeConfigurationAttribute for entity types #34710
    12.0-preview1
  • GetClrValueUsingContainingEntity returns default value instead of null if containing ComplexType is null #39683
  • ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete break with Many-To-Many and AutoInclude #35523
    12.0-preview1
  • JsonQueryCosmosTest are flaky (especially on CI) #34395
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Apply navigation expansion to the rest of a lifted GroupBy projection #39693
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39691
  • Fix precompiled queries over captured collections #39685

Merged

  • Make service provider context discovery best-effort in the tools #39562
    community-contribution
  • Revert SQL Server Application Name injection #39700
  • Reject negative timeouts in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39657
    community-contribution
  • Set SQL connection registered application for EF Core telemetry #39698
  • Validate the Cosmos session token management mode #39658
    community-contribution
  • Throw ObjectDisposedException from SqliteBlob.Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) #39656
    community-contribution
  • Don't turn a sub-second TimeSpan command timeout into no timeout #39655
    community-contribution
  • Validate enum values parsed from numeric strings in SqliteConnectionStringBuilder #39654
    community-contribution
  • Release completed migration instances #39520
    community-contribution
  • Don't scaffold a foreign key as one-to-one when its unique index is filtered #39574
    community-contribution
  • Fix split query paging order when limit/offset is pushed into a subquery #39687
    community-contribution
  • Allow multiple EntityTypeConfigurationAttribute declarations on entity types #39506
    community-contribution
  • Prune skip navigation includes in ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete #39515
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39642
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Drop removed database-level annotations after table and column operations #39666
    community-contribution
  • Identify rows of temporal range queries by their period #39661
    community-contribution
  • Cast all projected date/time and Guid constants #39659
    community-contribution
  • Propagate column nullability from failed CASE tests to later clauses #39660
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution
  • Count a reused parameterized collection once when checking the SQL Server parameter limit #39634
    community-contribution
  • Translate SelectMany over a grouping by flattening its rows #39602
    community-contribution
  • Resolve grouping aggregates to the query SQL evaluates them in #39451
    community-contribution
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations reached through an element s… #38960
    community-contribution
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations next to operator chains #39648
    community-contribution
  • Support complex properties on owned types #39522
    community-contribution
  • Avoid duplicate parameter counting for reused collection parameters (#39631) #39675
    community-contribution
  • Merge repeated single-row subqueries into one OUTER APPLY on SQL Server #39672
    community-contribution
  • Preserve complex property paths in snapshot keys #39650
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review, area-harness
  • Scaffold foreign keys whose column type differs from the principal key #39633
    community-contribution
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Fix enum.ToString() projection on SQL Server to use bounded string type mapping (#39667) #39676
    community-contribution
  • Simplify adding and dropping CHECK constraints for SQLite migrations #39488
    community-contribution
